item.title: Ancient climate records reveal how East Asian monsoon shifted abruptly into cold and drought
item.description: How does climate change affect the East Asian monsoon? Researchers from Utrecht University's Faculty of Geosciences, together with colleagues at research institutes in China and Belgium, are investigating this question by looking back 250,000 years. They found that, over long timescales, the monsoon system tracks changes in incoming solar radiation caused by variations in Earth's orbit and tilt. But when radiation falls below a certain threshold, abrupt periods of extreme cold and drought occur, particularly when atmospheric CO₂ concentrations are low. item.title: High water, high rents: Poorest residents pay the most for climate adaptation
item.description: As cities worldwide adapt to extreme weather, climate adaptation must prevent people from wading through flooded streets in the future. But the costs are not equally shared. In Copenhagen, stormwater costs fall disproportionately on not-for-profit housing residents, as these neighborhoods are often located near climate adaptation projects. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: El demócrata Scott Colom derrotó a la republicana Cindy Hyde-Smith en una reñida contienda; con esta victoria, la oposición alcanza los 55 escaños en el Senado Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.

item.title: As Venezuelans protest blackouts, U.S.-backed leader declares early Christmas
